decisions: Mandatory activities only by CTSV / Phòng ĐT (faculty-scoped Phòng ĐT limited to its faculties); voluntary only by an active club leader

Eligibility faculty AND class AND cohort, empty = all, shared SQL function activity_student_eligible

Eligibility by organisational unit not supported (assumption in ADR 0030)

decisions: One row per student per activity; REGISTERED and CANCEL_REQUESTED hold a seat
Capacity guarded by a DB trigger that locks the activity row; 10 concurrent registrations for 3 seats tested
Waitlist promoted in queue order on accepted cancellation and capacity increase, only before start
Cancellation request at least 24 h before start with a reason; pending at start = auto-accepted (activity_settle)
Absence derived (ended, seat held, no approved attendance); excused flag for 11.5
No one decides their own request; owner unit or owner/delegated club leader decides
limitations: Promotion notice shown on the activity page only; not in the submission-bound notification centre
Absence becomes final only once attendance exists (11.4)
No dedicated browser rehearsal yet; folded into 11.6

decisions: Static printed QR = HMAC(secret,'static'); optional rotating QR in 30 s windows; secret never leaves the server; owner can reset
Scan only during the activity with a held seat; 3-minute capture session; retry allowed only before a photo is sent
In-page front camera, no file picker; server keeps JPEG only, strips APP1-APP15/COM, stores SHA-256, private folder activity-photos
Owner unit or owner/delegated club reviews; no self-review; batch approval up to 100
Certificates CN-XXXXXXXXXXXX with payload SHA-256, NOT_VERIFIED, legal_effect=false, append-only; CTSV revokes with reason
Absence now excludes approved attendance; photos purged 90 days after the end (purgeExpiredPhotos)
limitations: Photo purge has no scheduler yet (Sprint 13 operations)
Camera needs HTTPS outside localhost; real-phone test pending Sprint 13
Rehearsal with fake camera folded into 11.6
Photo pixels are not inspected (no face or location verification, by design)
